content.short: Reactive Network is an event-driven execution layer whose contracts react to events on other chains.
content.description: Reactive Network runs what it calls reactive contracts, which execute in response to events emitted on other EVM chains rather than waiting to be called by a transaction. That inverts the usual model, where a smart contract is inert until someone pays to invoke it, and removes the need for an off-chain keeper watching for conditions.
content.meta: Reactive Network is an event-driven execution layer with contracts that react to cross-chain events.
